The firm aims to secure ₹1,250 crore through an initial public offering, designated for debt repayment and other corporate needs. A portion, ₹900 crore, will specifically address current borrowings. The IPO also includes an offer-for-sale of 1.81 crore shares, with proceeds benefiting the selling shareholders.

items.title: Poddar Keventer Capital Advisors to raise up to Rs 400 crore for maiden real estate AIF
items.summary: Poddar Keventer Capital Advisors Private Limited plans to raise up to Rs 400 crore for its Category II AIF. The fund will focus on real estate projects in Kolkata and Delhi over the next six years. Sponsors have committed to 20% of the target corpus, which stands at Rs 80 crore. The fund aims for a gross IRR of 18% to 22% before expenses.

items.title: Rupee sinks to 96.31, logs biggest fall in over 2 months
items.summary: The Indian rupee has markedly dipped against the US dollar, hitting 96.3150. This decline is attributed to escalating US bond yields, which have exerted pressure on emerging market currencies. Additionally, India’s primary equity indices have encountered their most prolonged downturn in 25 years, signaling a turbulent market climate. In tandem, the dollar index has surged to 101.9, exacerbating the rupee's depreciation and reflecting ongoing currency exchange volatility.

items.title: 10-year bond yield breaches 7.20%; hits 2.5-year high
items.summary: India's 10-year benchmark bond yields have surged to 7.21%, reaching their highest point in two and a half years. With oil prices continuing to soar and an anticipated rate hike, analysts predict these yields could escalate to 7.50% if the Reserve Bank of India enacts a 25 basis point increase. A substantial bond issuance is on the horizon, adding complexity to the supply-demand landscape.

items.title: Boeing 737 MAX software issue: US FAA to convene review on Friday
items.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will hold a safety review of a software issue affecting Boeing 737 MAX aircraft that could increase pilot workload during a go-around. The review could determine whether the issue affects certification of the 737 MAX 10, which has been delayed pending the FAA’s analysis. US officials and airline executives have said they do not currently view the issue as a safety concern.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares: Will stock finally reward its investors after Anup Bagchi as new MD-CEO?
items.summary: HDFC Bank has appointed Anup Bagchi as MD and CEO after RBI approval. He will succeed Sashidhar Jagdishan on October 27, 2026. Bagchi has vast experience in banking and insurance, previously serving as MD of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance.

items.title: Gandhi's thumb-rule ought to resonate across the ages no matter how large India’s economy grows
items.summary: In 1947, Mahatma Gandhi urged decision-makers to ask whether the poorest and weakest would benefit from their decisions. The test didn’t just survive India’s pursuit of rapid economic growth, it is all the more salient today.

items.title: Gold slips before US payrolls data, set for second weekly loss
items.summary: Gold prices are poised for their second consecutive weekly decline, driven by the strengthening US dollar and escalating Treasury yields. Investors are keenly anticipating vital US payroll figures that could sway the Federal Reserve's future policy decisions. Current predictions suggest only a 25% probability of a rate increase this month, which is a shift from previous projections.

items.title: NBCUniversal cuts hundreds of streaming tech jobs: What’s behind Comcast’s latest layoffs?
items.summary: Comcast’s NBCUniversal layoff: According to a report, most of the cuts are at Sky, Comcast's European media arm, though a person briefed on the change said some US-based workers at NBCU will also be affected.

items.title: Global Markets: Asian shares fall after wild swings in bonds, FX before US jobs data
items.summary: Asian stock markets dipped as investors navigated through the turbulence of bond and currency fluctuations. Elevated oil prices, driven by military strains in the Gulf region, added to the market's unease. Speculations around high US Treasury yields and fiscal instability in Europe, especially concerning French bonds, also weighed heavily. Furthermore, traders keep a close eye on upcoming US job data that may sway Federal Reserve policy.

items.title: Japan government bond yields fall as global markets steady
items.summary: Japanese government bond yields saw a significant drop on Friday, as the 10-year yield fell to levels not recorded since mid-September. Global bond markets stabilizing and shifts in central bank policies played a key role in this decline. Even though the Bank of Japan raised rates recently, inflation in Tokyo is rising, fueling predictions of additional rate hikes.

items.title: Oil prices edge higher, hover around $102 as US-Iran tensions, China fuel curbs support prices; MCX closed today
items.summary: Oil prices rose for a third straight session as China halted fuel exports and the US weighed additional military deployments to the Middle East. Brent crude rose 0.26% to $102.58 a barrel, while WTI gained 0.04% to $92.91. Markets also assessed tighter fuel supplies and rising geopolitical risks.

items.title: Boeing averts strike as engineers ratify deal: 32% pay hike over 4 years, 10% immediate raise | What the contract offers

The Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace reported a 67.6% approval from engineers and 53.5% from technicians, boosting Boeing shares by 3.4%.

items.title: US dollar climbs to 17-month high as bond rout, French fiscal worries weigh on euro
items.summary: The US dollar is experiencing a significant surge, reaching a 17-month peak as global bond yields continue to rise. Investor anxiety over inflation and increased government borrowing is steering market trends. As a result, yields on 10-year US Treasuries have soared to their highest point since 2002. Meanwhile, the euro is under pressure due to concerns regarding France's fiscal health and escalating political uncertainties in Europe.

items.title: Stock market holiday today: Are NSE, BSE closed for Gandhi Jayanti? Check 2026 holiday list
items.summary: Indian stock markets will remain closed on October 2 for Gandhi Jayanti, with trading resuming next week. MCX and NCDEX will also remain shut. items.summary: India will make facial recognition mandatory for airline and airport employees and expedite full-body scanner deployment at eight major airports as part of tighter aviation security measures. Smaller insurers are advocating for higher allowable expenses on initial premium bases to facilitate growth. These discussions follow the regulator's proposal to limit the expenses of management for life and general insurers. Industry executives believe a tiered structure can promote competition among insurers of different sizes.

items.title: US stocks: US market rebounds to close higher as surging Treasury yields recede
items.summary: US stocks recovered from earlier losses, with the S&P 500 bouncing back after a global bond selloff. The Labor Department reported a dip in weekly initial jobless claims, indicating a solid labor market. Oil prices surged, raising inflation concerns as Brent crude settled significantly higher. Technology shares also showed strength, particularly after Accenture's positive revenue forecast.

items.title: Vedanta Copper plans $2.3 billion capex, Tamil Nadu smelter restart back on agenda
items.summary: Vedanta Copper announced plans to invest $2.3 billion over three to four years to increase its output. The company aims to produce 500,000 tonnes of copper in India and 500,000 tonnes in Saudi Arabia. Officials are in advanced discussions to potentially restart the Tuticorin smelter, which has been inactive since 2018. If approved, they will invest $250 million to refurbish and restart this facility to enhance operations.

items.title: India-US trade deal 'not imminent' as 'sticking points' stay, USTR Greer says
items.summary: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the Trump administration is working with India to finalise a bilateral trade deal, but an agreement is not imminent. Greer said he had a “very constructive conversation” with Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal at the G20 trade ministers meeting and that officials remain engaged.

items.title: India’s fuel demand splits in September as petrol, diesel rise and LPG falls
items.summary: Petrol and diesel sales increased in September by 7.2% and 4.9% year-on-year, respectively. The rise in petrol consumption was supported by higher vehicle sales during the month. Meanwhile, diesel demand was boosted due to below-normal monsoon rainfall and increased economic activity. Aviation turbine fuel sales experienced flat growth, indicating subdued air traffic. LPG consumption fell by 9% as disruptions from the war impacted supplies.

items.title: NCLT rejects Uniton Infra insolvency plea against Shapoorji Pallonji over Rs 4.31 crore claim
items.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal rejected Uniton Infra’s plea seeking insolvency proceedings against Shapoorji Pallonji & Co over an alleged Rs 4.31 crore default linked to road resurfacing work in Nellore. The tribunal said one invoice fell under the Covid-era ban on bankruptcy filings, while the remaining claim was below the Rs 1 crore threshold.

items.title: Govt warns Nayara, RIL-BP against fuel sales caps amid diesel curb reports
items.summary: Oil secretary Neeraj Mittal stated that restricting fuel sales at pumps is unacceptable during a press conference. He emphasized that no companies are permitted to cap fuel sales. Reports indicate that Nayara Energy and Reliance Industries-BP joint venture have limited diesel sales. The increase in international diesel prices has affected the domestic supply. Mittal reiterated that the government's stance on this issue remains unchanged.

items.title: Fed’s Jefferson urges patience on rates; Kashkari sees more hikes ahead
items.summary: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson stated that he sees no immediate need for further interest rate adjustments. He emphasized that future decisions would depend on analyzing economic data trends and risks. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari expressed uncertainty regarding the timing of the next rate hike amidst strong economic performance. Both officials acknowledged the ongoing challenges of managing inflation that exceeds the 2% target.

items.title: ‘India’s biotech ecosystem holds tremendous promise’: Eli Lilly CEO
items.summary: Eli Lilly has experienced significant growth, reaching a market capitalization over $1 trillion. The company aims to maintain its leadership in anti-obesity drugs through ongoing innovation and development. With successful trials for drugs like retatrutide and Foundayo, Lilly is expanding its product offerings. The company recognizes the importance of India as a growing market for healthcare investments and partnerships.

items.title: ARCs seek govt help to speed up recovery
items.summary: Asset reconstruction companies have called for improved government intervention to accelerate debt recovery through DRTs. They proposed changes including automatic lapse of interim stays after two months and better notification processes for creditors. Additionally, they requested timely filling of DRT vacancies and enhanced electronic services for litigation. The Sarfaesi Act has been highlighted as an essential tool for banks in asset recovery.

items.title: Anushka Sharma-backed Slurrp Farm explores fresh fundraise as existing investors eye exit
items.summary: Slurrp Farm is currently exploring new fundraising opportunities as existing investors consider exiting their holdings. The company aims to attract potential investors while discussing the details of the proposed deal. Founded by Meghana Narayan and Shauravi Malik, Slurrp Farm has leveraged supergrains in their products. Recently, the brand was valued at ₹827 crore during a Series C5 funding round. Investor interest continues to rise in the healthy snacking market.

items.title: Strong macro show takes shape in Q2 before festive rush
items.summary: India's economy is experiencing significant growth, highlighted by a 14.7% increase in goods and services tax collections in September. Car sales surged by 21% year-on-year, indicating strong consumer demand during the festive season. Manufacturing activity is robust, contributing to a rise in the HSBC Purchasing Managers Index to a seven-month high.

items.title: ET Graphics: Factory engine revs up jobs and earnings rise
items.summary: India’s factory workforce crossed 20 million in 2024-25, driven by gains in West Bengal, Telangana, Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh and sectors such as food products and electrical equipment. Industrial GVA rose 9.6% to Rs 26.9 lakh crore, while average earnings increased to Rs 3.8 lakh. Productivity edged up to Rs 11 lakh per worker.

items.title: India’s city hotels find a new growth engine in weekend getaways
items.summary: Weekend demand at city hotels in India is improving, driven by rising staycations and increased domestic travel. Occupancy levels have significantly increased in 2026, with Mumbai and New Delhi recording substantial gains. Major hotel chains like Radisson and Ibis report favorable trends in occupancy rates and average daily rates. This shift in consumer behavior marks a notable change in the hospitality landscape post-Covid-19.

items.title: Pension savings may get bigger infrastructure play as PFRDA explores direct project exposure
items.summary: The government is seeking to channel more pension savings into India’s long-term infrastructure needs, with PFRDA chairman S Ramann saying the regulator is exploring additional avenues, including direct exposure to large projects. CEA V Anantha Nageswaran called pension savings patient, long-duration capital suited to financing long-lived infrastructure assets.

items.title: Vedanta plans $200 million push to lift Rajasthan oil output
items.summary: Vedanta Oil and Gas is increasing investment in Rajasthan to enhance crude output from existing wells. The company aims to invest approximately $200 million in 2026-27 across several fields in the region. Further, Vedanta plans to develop a new hub for gas growth in the northeast region. Enhanced-recovery techniques are being employed to increase production efficiency from their wells.

items.title: RBI asks banks to tackle repeat customer complaints, fix gaps in grievance systems
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has asked banks to identify systemic, process and operational gaps behind recurring customer complaints and conduct root-cause analysis to reduce their recurrence. The regulator also called for stronger capacity building and grievance handling. More than 1.33 million complaints were received under the ombudsman scheme in FY25.

items.title: Finance ministry sees Q2 FY27 GDP growth at 7.3%, flags trade, crude and AI risks
items.summary: The finance ministry expects India’s real GDP to grow 7.3% in Q2 FY27, above the RBI’s 6.4% forecast, but warned that global uncertainties could weigh on investment. US trade relations, tariff pressures, crude prices and the lack of an India angle in global AI developments are clouding investor interest.

items.title: Piyush Goyal, US trade envoy Greer discuss early conclusion of India-US interim trade deal
